settings.description: A familiar silhouette. A different perspective. Discover every curve of the blue-and-white TN.

settings.intro: Follow the details that make this silhouette unmistakable. A closer look at the model, from its blue upper to its black outsole.
settings.part_1_body: Sky blue at the forefoot, deeper blue toward the heel. The color moves with the shape.
settings.part_2_body: White ribs trace the side profile, framing the blue panels beneath.
settings.part_3_body: A sculpted white midsole frames the visible cushioning windows.
settings.part_4_body: The dark tread anchors the palette and defines the shoe from below.
settings.part_5_body: White laces, a padded collar and a small side Swoosh complete the composition.

settings.heading: Closer changes everything.
settings.panel_1_body: Move from the light blue forefoot into the deeper tones at the heel. The white cage gives every panel its own edge.
settings.panel_2_body: Curved ribs, layered panels and the side Swoosh. A study in the details of an instantly recognizable profile.
settings.panel_3_body: Turn the silhouette over. Dark tread, blue accents and a sculpted arch give the underside its own identity.

settings.heading: Lines & layers
settings.row_1_body: A long, low silhouette with white waves moving across a blue upper.
settings.row_2_body: Bright white framing, translucent details and a dark outsole bring the layers into focus.
settings.row_3_body: Dark tread beneath a white midsole. Blue accents continue around the arch.

settings.story: A blue upper framed by white waves. The dark outsole gives the light silhouette a distinct edge.

settings.manifesto: White curves divide the blue panels. The same line carries from the forefoot to the heel, a small detail that holds the whole silhouette together.
